messages:
marco (Finance): Quick one — OrbitWave says their Q2 reserved-rate proration didn't apply after a mid-cycle plan change on INV-4625. They contacted AE asking for a correction.
ivy-csm: Customer upgraded mid-billing period; expected prorated reserved discount to carry through. AE already asked for a breakdown.
andre-billing: Pulling invoice and plan-change event. One sec.
andre-billing: Found plan_change event 2026-06-10T05:12Z, invoice generated 2026-06-15. Looks like the proration flag wasn't set on the invoice renderer for mid-cycle upgrades.
sara-pricing: We changed proration logic in pricing service during the Q2 refactor (PR #1402) and forgot to add a backward-compat shim. It ignored proration windows if legacy_flag=false.
marco (Finance): Can we compute the missed proration discount amount so we can propose a credit?
andre-billing: Quick calc: reserved-rate delta saved = $1.20/hr for 720 hours prorated fraction 0.67 => missed discount = $581.76. Rounding to $582.
ivy-csm: Customer also asks for a $150 good-faith credit for AE time.
marco (Finance): Proposed total credit = $732. Approve? Need credit memo and journal entry.
billing-bot: Created ticket FIN-1204 (proration-missed-credit) and uploaded invoice export /secure/exports/INV-4625-prorate.csv
marco (Finance): Approving manual credit of $732. @billing-bot create credit memo and post to ledger.
billing-bot: Credit memo CM-869 created for $732. Journal JE-2026-06-INV4625 posted.
andre-billing: Adding a migration task to add proration backward-compatibility test and sweep invoices generated 2026-06-01..2026-06-20.
ivy-csm: I'll notify the customer with the breakdown and timing once CM posts.
marco (Finance): Thanks team  closing FIN-1204 when customer confirms receipt.
